name: An accepted requirement change recalculates the exact outcome once and honours disabled queued alerts
description: Focused deterministic journey; explicit reusable Python assertions are stored alongside this authored plan. Isolated labelled fixtures only for source mutations.

planSteps.description: Sign in isolated operator VAR_{operator_email} with VAR_{password}; click the Eligibility and notifications button (assert it is pressed) in Isolated source verification, publish valid snapshot to establish target-level master.

Sign in VAR_{other_email} in its independent browser context with VAR_{password}. Dismiss an unfinished-profile prompt if needed; open /settings/profile. Save Nigeria citizenship, Ghana residence, bachelor current qualification and completed status. In Your plans set the exact Intended future qualification field to master, not bachelor; set Computer Science. Save & continue, then Save & see my matches. Save [TEST ONLY] Controlled change scholarship. Enable in-app change notifications and disable email.

Mandatory setup checkpoint: reload /settings/profile, open Your plans, and verify Intended future qualification is still master. Fail setup if it is bachelor or was not saved. Return to matches and update until complete. Do not diagnose the evaluator using a profile that differs from this master requirement.

Baseline checkpoint BEFORE publishing any changed requirement: as the configured other student, verify [TEST ONLY] Controlled change scholarship is eligible for the persisted master profile and the current master requirement. Record the baseline accepted version. Do not evaluate this baseline checkpoint after changing the requirement.

Sign in as operator, reopen Isolated source verification, explicitly click the Eligibility and notifications button (assert it is pressed) again, and publish the changed requirement (bachelor). Record the NEW accepted version C displayed in the result.

Process bounded application jobs until the current work drains. As the other student with target master, verify the current version C is now not_eligible with VALUE_NOT_ACCEPTED. This rejection is the EXPECTED post-change result. Verify exactly one change alert for version C, using its accepted-version/event context. Older alerts for other accepted versions must remain in history and do not count as duplicates. Total unread count or repeated scholarship titles cannot establish duplicate delivery.
Replay the changed snapshot and process jobs; assert unchanged version and exactly one same event alert.
Publish valid reverse change, disable student change topic before processing queued jobs, then process to drain. Assert no reverse-version notification. Restore change preference.
